answer_sql:
SELECT
  p.brand,
  c.country_name AS customer_country,
  SUM(s.net_amount) AS net_revenue
FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line AS s
JOIN contoso_served.dim_product AS p
  ON s.product_key = p.product_key
JOIN contoso_served.dim_customer AS cu
  ON s.customer_key = cu.customer_key
JOIN contoso_served.dim_country AS c
  ON cu.country_code = c.country_code
WHERE
  s.order_date BETWEEN CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2024-12-31' AS DATE)
  AND c.is_placeholder = FALSE
GROUP BY
  p.brand,
  c.country_name
ORDER BY
  p.brand ASC,
  net_revenue DESC
